name: Rank-Two Ample Classes Are Strictly Dismantlable Ample
scope: Finite ample classes and their one-inclusion graphs.
statement: Every ample class of VC dimension at most two has a corner peeling, while dismantlable ample classes may have larger VC dimension.
proof: The inclusion is the rank-two corner-peeling theorem. The cube $Q_3$ has the support-size order as an ample-prefix order and has VC dimension three.
